description: Public holidays of any country (and state or region: US states, German Laender, Australian states, UK nations ...) for 2026, 2027 or 2028, with weekday and observed days, plus the LONG WEEKENDS (3+ days off in a row) and the BRIDGE DAYS worth taking off ('take Fri 7 May off = 4 days in a row'). For HR and leave apps, payroll and delivery planning, travel sites and chat bots. Free: 5 calls/day per IP.
